heading: TABLE XV—Part II—Bi-lingualism
layout: rows = taluk x mother tongue; columns = persons speaking mother tongue (P/M/F, cols 3-5) and subsidiary languages Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu (M/F, cols 6-11)
notes: Page 146 (left). Taluks Kunnathunad, Muvattupula, Thodupula, Minachil (Northern Division, concluded; no Northern total on this page), then High Range Division total, taluks Pirmede, Devikulam. Minachil prints no Konkani or Marathi rows. PRINT INCONSISTENCY: Kunnathunad Malayalam persons printed 222,691 (last digit damaged but reads 1), while males 110,255 + females 112,439 = 222,694, and 222,694 is needed for the column to reach the printed Total 226,021 and for Northern taluks to reach the Northern Division figure 1,644,481; kept as printed. Pirmede Total females printed '.9.292' with leading digit broken; recorded 19,292 (= 45,852 - 26,560 and column sum). Some Tamil/Telugu subsidiary figures sit half a line above their labels; assigned by order, confirmed by totals. Northern Division = sum of its 6 taluks (pp.144, 146) in every cell apart from the two items noted; High Range = Pirmede + Devikulam in every cell.
